en:
The next time we come out of the 
trial grounds, it'll all be over, right!?
W-We can win, right...?
O-Of course...

It'll be okay... This class trial should be
much easier than the others.
Huh? Why?

Up until now, we had to find the culprits among
the people in our group during the class trials.

That's why we couldn't work together even if we
wanted to. But...this time, it's different.

Ah, since there isn't a culprit among us,
we can work together without any doubts.

We're all going to be working together
this time... I already feel more at ease!

But...I wish it had happened sooner.
At the beginning, there were 16 of us...

But now there's only 4 of us standing here,
plus Keebo who's coming later.

...We're about to head to the last battle.
Why are you so depressed?
Oh, sorry... You're right.
...Thank you for waiting.
That was fast, Keebo.

<CLT=cltMIND>His weapons have been removed. I suppose
we don't have to worry about him attacking...

Wh-What? Are you disappointed?
Did you prefer your sci-fi gear after all?
No, it's not that...
I'm just...very sorry!
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo bowed at the waist to us.

I acted recklessly and put you all in
serious danger...
I'm sorry! I'm very, very sorry!

Huh? What's wrong? You're totally different
from before when you were in battle mode...

...Shuichi, you told me earlier not to give up
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
Th-That's right...
I finally realized that you were right...
My inner voice told me...

Your inner voice? I thought you said
you couldn't hear it anymore...

Well, I had the Monokubs repair me in addition
to removing my battle gear...

And now, for some reason, I can hear my
inner voice again.

<CLT=cltMIND>So he can hear it again
after the repairs...

<CLT=cltMIND>But it looks like...
His hair...looks like...an antenna...

<CLT=cltMIND>Does that mean it wasn't
just decoration?

<CLT=cltMIND>And now that I think about it, what is his
"inner voice" exactly? What does he hear?

I was wrong to try to destroy everything
just to avoid losing to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>...

Even if I had followed though, there would've
been no <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> or <CLT=cltSTRONG>future<CLT=typeNORMAL> left afterward.

In which case, my actions would have merely
resulted in a different <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> altogether.

...I do not expect you to forgive me.
What I did was foolish.

But...will you allow me to fight alongside
you!? I want to help you find the truth!
Please!

Of course, Keebo.
That's what I've wanted from the start.

If it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have been
able to do this.
So...you'll allow me?

Oh... You seem angry, Tsumugi.
Would you prefer I not help...?
I'm not mad...I'm just holding myself back.

When someone says "please" that strongly,
I always want to respond with, "But I refuse."

But I can read the mood here...
So I'm holding back.
Well of course.

Yeah, I'm okay now! Of course you can
fight with us, Keebo!

There's a big wall between living things and
objects, but you're our friend, Keebo.
Th-Thank you...

Um... By the way, Maki, I've been meaning
to ask you, but...

What is that...vacuum cleaner you're
carrying?

...It's the Bugvac. I think Kokichi designed
it and had Miu make it.

Ah yes, Gonta had mentioned something
about <CLT=cltSTRONG>tiny bugs<CLT=typeNORMAL> before...

Yes, I thought it could be
a clue to something.

But we can't seem to catch any bugs
with it. It doesn't seem like there are any.

So it really was just Gonta's imagination,
after all.
Wait, it might be too soon to determine that.

Can we...wait until I've examined it with
my eyes, at least?
<CLT=cltMIND>Your eyes?
What do you mean, Keebo?

What good can your eyes do? It's not like
you've got good eyesight, right?

That was true...until I installed my zoom
function.
...Your zoom function?

It was in my lab, next to the jet pack and
rocket launcher...

Thanks to that zoom function, my vision
has increased a hundredfold.
A hundredfold!?

That's a power-up that goes way past
your default settings!

This is the true talent of the Ultimate
Robot...

Because I'm a robot, I can evolve in ways
that are simply not possible for a human.
I've...finally accepted that.

There are notable differences between us,
but they're nothing for me to be ashamed of.

Because...with my <CLT=cltSTRONG>talent<CLT=typeNORMAL>, it's possible that
I can save you all.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo took the Bugvac from
Maki, and...

It's worth a shot. At maximum zoom, my vision
is on par with that of a microscope.
...Maki, I'll borrow this Bugvac for a moment.
<CLT=cltMIND>He stared at it intensely.

...I see it!
I'll print out this memory!

<CLT=cltMIND>Just as before, Keebo printed a
picture from right out of his mouth.

<CLT=cltMIND>He took it from his lips
and handed it to me.
Is this...Monokuma!?

Are these the <CLT=cltSTRONG>small bugs<CLT=typeNORMAL> Gonta was talking
about?

A human's eyes would not be able to see
things that exist at a nanoscopic level.

For Gonta to have noticed them...
his vision really was superhuman.

Hey, what are these things holding?
Are they holding cameras?
...Why don't we ask them?
We can *talk* to this?

Yes, I have already installed an augmented
hearing function.
I-I guess anything is possible...

Start talking. Now.
Or I'll squish you one by one.

Whatever function you serve, you'll be
unable to carry it out...
Do you accept these terms?

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo asked in a way that made it
clear it was not up for negotiation.

They call themselves...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Nanokumas<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
Apparently they're members of the Monokubs.
What? This little thing...?
Then there were actually six Monokubs?

Not quite. These don't exist as individuals,
but rather as a hivemind.

They travel through the air in a swarm,
covering every square inch of this campus.

<CLT=cltMIND>So it's not just one...it's a
whole swarm of Monokubs.

If they're that small, they coulda been 
in my nose or mouth and I'd never know.
I don't like the thought of that...
And their function...

is to record footage of the events that are
unfolding here, and transmit it to Monokuma.
...What?

Using their tiny cameras, they record
footage and transmit it wirelessly...

Motherkuma receives the footage and parses
it before sending it off to Monokuma.
You mean...like a security camera!?

<CLT=cltMIND>They're so small that they can't be
seen with the naked eye...
<CLT=cltMIND>They must be the security cameras!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Sixth Monokub<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
S-So there were security cameras after all.

And they'd been recording the footage
wirelessly...
Kokichi was correct to use the Electrobomb.

When he used it, the Nanokumas were unable
to send any footage back to Monokuma.

Yes, in that case, I doubt Monokuma
knew the real culprit.

Umm...the more I learn, the more I wish that
Kokichi had just worked with us normally.

That's impossible. No matter how many times
he reincarnates, he's a liar down to his soul.

<CLT=cltMIND>I never would have imaged that the sixth
Monokub would be security cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's how Monokuma was able to
keep watch of this entire academy.
<CLT=cltMIND>...He's toying with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>He's not just confident.
He's *sure* he's going to win.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that must be what
he's thinking...

...At least we know that important detail now.
I'm glad you told us before the class trial.
Yeah! Thanks Keebo!
You're welcome, but...we should get going now.

...Yeah, we don't know what Monokuma will
do if we show up late.

Y-You're right... Then let's start heading
to the trial grounds.
...Okay.
I'm glad I was able to help.

I wouldn't want you to think my sci-fi weaponry
is the only growth I've displayed thus far.

...Well then, let's go.
Monokuma is expecting us.
Maki, you brought that thing with you, huh?

You act like you're cold and distant,
but you're suprisingly warm and serious...

I finally feel like I've figured out 
how close we are now.
In the end, we couldn't find the mastermind.

They must be really good at hide and seek.
But...they can't escape my magic.

I'll hit them with my "All Your Relationships
Will End Up Being Love Triangles" curse!
Th-That would be...very helpful, Himiko.
With Keebo's eyes, huh...?

If Gonta couldn't even see it, I doubt Keebo
would be able to see it either.

Relax. If we end up failing, and it comes time
for me to kill you...

I'll make sure to end your life swiftly,
so you won't have to suffer.
...Th-Thank you?
Keebo...seems completely different from earlier.

Maybe it's like...equipping all those weapons
enhanced his feelings too.

It happens with cosplay too. When you wear a
cosplay, you start acting like that character.

Gonta discovered it, Kokichi made a design,
Miu built the device...

It was because of all of them that Keebo
was able to find the final clue.
It's almost like...everyone's cheering us on.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo's eyes? What does he mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>Let's go! To the final trial,
with my friends!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo's eyes? What does he mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>Let's go! To the final trial,
with my friends!
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo's eyes? What does he mean?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*rumble rumble!*
<CLT=cltMIND>Alright... Let's go.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no point in worrying anymore.
Right now...

<CLT=cltMIND>we only need to think about
getting out of here alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>And so, we put the destroyed Ultimate Academy
behind us...
<CLT=cltMIND>and headed to the final trial grounds.

<CLT=cltMIND>Carrying the last of the survivors,
the elevator brought us down.
<CLT=cltMIND>What could be waiting for the five of us?
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure...this is the end of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>And the beginning of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything ends here.
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything.

<CLT=cltMIND>The killing game of Hope's Peak Academy...
The killing game of Jabberwock Island...
<CLT=cltMIND>And the killing game of this Ultimate Academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>How much more until they're satisfied?
This is the end of it.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm...tired of this.
<CLT=cltMIND>We're going to end it.
<CLT=cltMIND>We're going to end this cruel game.
